name: deep-web-search
description: Four-provider parallel web search with source cleaning, content extraction, evidence checks, and automatic summary fallback.

exaApiKey.description: Optional Exa API key. Without it, Exa MCP is used.

tinyfishApiKey.description: TinyFish API key from the TinyFish console.

codexModel.description: Codex model used by the web-search provider.

codexThinkingEffort.description: Thinking effort for the Codex web-search model; empty uses the model default.

maxResults.description: Maximum distinct sources returned by one query.

fetchContent.description: Fetch source bodies in the background.

summaryModel.description: Model spec such as openai-codex/gpt-6-astra; empty disables model summaries.

summaryThinkingEffort.description: Thinking effort for the summary model; empty uses the model default.

workflow.description: Result workflow selected by the user.
